meta.title: Mira - Your next hire is already out there.

adaptedFrom.reason: Spec/POM/baseline originally generated against a Railway preview deployment where the account had 4 connectors (Market Leads + Mira Voice, immutable 'Connected' native presets; Outlook + Gmail, 'Not Connected'). Live re-verification against production (same account, https://mira.day/settings/connectors) on 2026-07-03 found only 2 connectors — Outlook + Gmail, BOTH 'Not Connected' — no 'Connected' section and no Market Leads / Mira Voice preset exist in this account/environment. This baseline reflects the production reality; it is a genuine feature-scope difference, not a broken locator.

S2.name: Connect entry point pending (Outlook)

interactives.note: disabled while authorizingId is set, pending the popup

S2.notes: Click fires POST /api/mcp/servers/{id}/authorize, then window.open() launches a genuine Microsoft OAuth consent popup (login.microsoftonline.com/.../oauth2/v2.0/authorize, redirect_uri -> backend.composio.dev, client_id visible in URL) as a SEPARATE browser page. Main /settings/connectors tab does NOT navigate away and stays functional with the button in a disabled+spinner pending state. Popup was closed without completing login (per task instructions: do not complete OAuth on production). Page was reloaded afterward to clear the pending spinner state and confirmed to return cleanly to S0.

locatorProfile.dominantStrategy: aria-label / role+name (no data-testid anywhere in this component tree); row containers themselves have no aria-label, only nested action buttons do — use getByRole('button', { name: /ServerName/ }) matching the composite accessible name for row-level clicks

keyFindings: Production account (same as preview) has only 2 connectors: Outlook + Gmail, BOTH 'Not Connected'. No 'Connected' section exists at all — this differs from the Railway preview deployment used for the original spec generation, which had 4 connectors including 2 immutable native presets (Market Leads, Mira Voice). Confirmed a genuine feature-scope difference via live CDP, not a locator regression.

Detail view (drill-down) for a needsAuth connector (Outlook) shows h1 + a bare-text 'Connect' header action button + a 'Connect to see available tools' (connectFirst) placeholder — no Tools label, no switches. This is a different detail-view branch than the immutable-preset branch documented in the original baseline.

Connect entry point (Outlook) verified functional end-to-end up to the OAuth handoff: POST /authorize succeeded, a real Microsoft OAuth consent popup opened as a separate page (login.microsoftonline.com, via backend.composio.dev redirect). Did NOT complete the OAuth flow — popup was closed and main page reloaded to reset pending spinner state.

NOTE for downstream test generation (not a bug): this QA workspace's local messages/en.json is missing the entire settings.connectors i18n dictionary (only a bare 'connectors' nav label exists). Real keys live in the Mira repo at apps/mira-work/i18n/messages/en/agent.json (settings.connectors namespace). Spec/POM generators must pull i18n text from there, not from this project's local messages dir, per e2e-flakiness-playbook.md §2.

No data-testid attributes exist anywhere in this component tree; locators must rely on aria-label (present on Back button, section trigger, and Connect action buttons) or composite accessible name matching for the clickable row containers themselves (which have no aria-label).
